prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1269; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Claimant reports being the driver of the vehicle struck on the passenger side. Claimant states they were proceeding on a green signal when the other vehicle entered the intersection. Initial photos of both vehicles requested from claimant. Liability under review pending police report and statements.

Entry 2: Claimant contacted by phone. Reports pain and limited movement in the left wrist following the collision and states they were transported to an urgent care facility by ambulance. Claimant has not retained an attorney and says they are handling the claim directly. Explained the claims process and the need for medical documentation. Requested copies of all treatment records and imaging.

Entry 3: Received urgent care records indicating a diagnosis of a fracture to the wrist, with a splint applied and referral to an orthopedic specialist. Claimant has scheduled a follow-up appointment with the specialist. Noted that a surgical consult may be required depending on the findings. Will reassess reserves once the specialist's assessment is available.

Entry 4: Obtained police report. Investigating officer notes the other driver stated the light had turned yellow as they entered the intersection. Witness statement from a pedestrian at the corner supports the claimant's account of the signal phase. Liability position currently leaning toward the other driver but not yet finalized. Vehicle damage appraisal scheduled for the claimant's vehicle.

Entry 5: Claimant advised of preliminary liability assessment and that the claim remains open pending medical treatment completion. Claimant asked about the process for reimbursement of medical costs and rental vehicle expenses. Provided written summary of coverage options and next steps. Claimant to send updated specialist report when available. Follow-up set for review of medical file.
